title: Leave categories and recent changes
objectives: Locate current leave guidance and avoid outdated figures.
explanation: Leave categories include sickness, necessary personal business, maternity, qualifying spouse support, sterilization, military service and training, each with conditions and payment rules. Sick leave and paid sick-leave limits are different concepts. Do not use an old overview as the sole source for current allowances.

The official explanation of the 2025 amendment, effective 7 December 2025, describes maternity leave of up to 120 days with employer-paid wages up to 60 days. It also describes up to 15 days of qualifying continuous child-care leave at 50% wages with the required medical evidence, and up to 15 days to assist a spouse who gives birth, paid in full, subject to the application and 90-day timing rules. These are statutory summaries, not AITS benefits. HR/legal review must confirm current text and individual eligibility before release.
example: An older Ministry overview still says 90 maternity days. The newer official amendment explanation supersedes that figure for the relevant covered situation.
exercise: Write a respectful request for current leave guidance without sharing medical details in a group chat.
model_response: Please confirm the applicable leave category, current entitlement, required documents and private submission channel for my circumstances.
key_points: Leave duration and pay are separate
